notes.title: Devlog #3
notes.notes:
Hey hey, cosmic adventurers! 👾

A massive thanks to everyone who checked out the Tears Apart demo during Steam Next Fest! 🌌 Your feedback has been absolutely incredible, and it's given us tons of ideas to make the game even better. We’re so excited that we’ve decided to take a bit more time to bring these features to life, so we’re moving the full release to Q1 2025! But don’t worry—demo updates are still on the way, so keep playing and exploring! 🚀

[h2]What’s Cooking in the Cosmic Cauldron? 🔥[/h2]
We’re not just fixing things; we’re gearing up to add some awesome new features to the demo. Here’s a peek at what’s on the way:

[list]
[*] [b]FTUE Revamp:[/b] Making things more intuitive and easy to understand.
[*] [b]Rebalancing[/b] for a faster game flow. Get ready to dash through the cosmos!
[*] [b]Secondary Skill Update:[/b] Now even more effective for epic combos.
[*] [b]Star Warp:[/b] Don’t ask—just wait! 🚀
[*] [b]Combat UX:[/b] Making things clearer and slicker for battles.
[*] [b]Fresh Sound Effects[/b] for that immersive touch.
[*] [b]Starchart Polish: [/b]Because stars deserve to shine their best. 🌟
[*] [b]Menus Polish[/b] to make everything smoother.
[*] [b]Lobby:[/b] Adding a cozy spot between runs to sip some tea and recharge. ☕️
[*] [b]Permanent Upgrades:[/b] So you feel a little stronger each time.
[*] [b]Music Polish:[/b] Tunes for your space adventure.
[*] [b]Combat Test & Revamp:[/b] Some interesting changes are on the way—get ready! 😏
[/list]
[h2]Endless Thanks![/h2]
Your feedback has been out of this world, and we’re more excited than ever to keep building Tears Apart together. Keep sending in those thoughts, and stay tuned—the cosmic adventure’s only getting started! 🌠

Until next time, cosmic adventurers! 🚀

K.

notes.title: Tears Apart Demo Update: Faster, Smoother, and Packed with Cosmic Fixes!
notes.notes:
We’ve just released a shiny new update for the Tears Apart demo, and oh boy, did we fix some things! Here’s what’s changed:
[list]
[*] [b]Map size was HUGE.[/b] Until we add more content, we’ve decided to shrink it a bit. Now you’ll be finding stars more often—no more wandering aimlessly through the cosmos. 🌟
[*] [b]We found a magic button that boosts the game by 30 FPS.[/b] And yes, we pressed it. 💥 You’re welcome.
[*] [b]Interstellar synergies are here![/b] These red-framed beauties are gonna shake things up in the best way possible. 🚀
[*] [b]Enemies scaling too fast? [/b]We noticed it too. Now they’ll chill a little more as you explore.
[*] [b]Fewer enemies per room. [/b]Yep, we’ve toned it down for better readability. Now you can actually see who (or what) is attacking you! 👀
[*] [b]Border rooms were way too big sometimes. [/b]We’ve fixed that, making them much more manageable!
[*] [b]Sound and music settings now work instantly in both the main menu AND the pause menu. [/b]You can now tweak those tunes anytime. 🎶
[*] [b]Dashy enemies nerfed! [/b]They now have a cooldown. No more endlessly dashing enemies harassing you! 😎
[*] [b]Controller dash issue? [/b]Gone! That annoying dash sticking bug when playing with a controller is history.
[*] [b]Room Guards won’t fly out of the room anymore. [/b]They’ve learned to stand their ground—no more knockback throwing them across the galaxy. 💪
[/list]
Thank you all for your feedback and for playing the demo! 🚀 Let us know what you think of these changes, and keep the suggestions coming. Until next time, cosmic adventurers! 🌌✨

notes.title: Tears Apart Demo Now Live for Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
🚀 It’s finally here, cosmic adventurers! 🌌

We’ve just dropped the Tears Apart demo for Steam Next Fest! 🎉 Get ready to dash, slash, and tear through the cosmos in this early hands-on experience. It’s time to try out those epic upgrades, battle mystical enemies, and maybe even face off against a boss or two. 👀

We can’t wait for you to jump in and share your thoughts! Play the demo and let us know how your intergalactic journey goes. 🗺️✨

Your feedback fuels our cosmic engines, so drop us your thoughts in the comments or right here in the community! 🚀

notes.title: Devlog #2
notes.notes:
[b]Hey hey, cosmic adventurers![/b] 👾

We’ve been hard at work laying the foundation for Tears Apart, and let’s just say, things are getting pretty epic (and slightly ridiculous in the best way possible). Here’s a taste of what we’ve been cooking up:

[list]
[*] [b]Enemies?[/b] Oh, they’re readable, they’re fun, and they’re ready to ruin your day (in a totally fair and strategic way, of course). Plus, the atmosphere? Dark and mystical, just the way we like it. 🌌
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45166596/8ac8adf981ab84a25cb835d95fc3475296f2ef02.png[/img]
[b]And the best part?[/b] Sometimes we think these enemies are learning faster than we are. Seriously… it’s a little spooky.

[list]
[*] [b]The HUD?[/b] Oh yeah, it’s looking sharp. We’re just making sure everything fits in the perfect spot, so if you’ve got any ideas where those UI elements should go… let us know. We’ll pretend it was our idea. 😉
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45166596/d1e5ed5c1ea20e61a96c5ec142261208009a8f54.png[/img]
You’ll see it and say, “That’s some sleek HUD.” Or you won’t… but we’ll know.

[list]
[*] [b]Starchart + Upgrades = one cosmic menu.[/b] You get stats. You get stars. You get upgrades. It’s like an intergalactic buffet, but for strategy nerds. 😎
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45166596/1b1cd9d036070567c9b44beaf511b3eb341b7740.png[/img]
Pro tip: if you stare at the Starchart long enough, you might see the universe reveal itself… or maybe just more upgrades.

And now, the cosmic secrets we’ve been hiding in the cauldron:

[list]
[*] [b]Procedural map generation?[/b] Yep, it’s happening. Prepare for some serious map variety and difficulty that ramps up quicker than we expected. 🎮 Also, maps that aren’t just the same room over and over. We promise.
[*] [b]New enemy types![/b] Each constellation will have its own themed enemies. They’re smart, they’re tough, and they’re probably laughing at us right now. 6 out of 10 of them are cooler than us. The other 4 just try too hard.
[*] [b]Upgrades?[/b] Oh boy, we’ve got tons of ‘em. If things go well, the demo is gonna have enough ways to make you feel overpowered. If not… well, you’ll just feel “slightly” overpowered. 💪
[*] [b]Bosses?[/b] Oh yeah, they’re coming. Big, bad, and epic enough to make you question your life choices.
[/list]
We LOVE hearing your thoughts and feedback. It’s what powers our dev engines (and our coffee makers). So keep ‘em coming! 🚀

Until next time,
K.

notes.title: 1,000 Wishlists – You All Are Amazing!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 🎉

Chat, is this real? We’ve hit 1,000 wishlists for Tears Apart, and honestly, we’re still picking our jaws off the floor! 🤯  A HUGE thank you to everyone who’s wishlisted the game – you’ve made us so happy, we might just shed a tear (see what we did there? 😉).

But wait, there’s more! 🌟 A demo is dropping during Steam Next Fest! You’ll finally get to dash, slash, and tear through the cosmos in person. We’re already imagining all the epic builds and wild strategies you’ll come up with – and honestly, we can’t wait to hear what you think!

Stay tuned to our devlogs for more updates, sneak peeks, and maybe a surprise or two (who knows, maybe there are even more cosmic secrets waiting to be uncovered… 👀).

Thanks again for making our space-faring dreams come true! 🚀

Until next time,
K.

notes.title: Devlog #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! ✨

Welcome to the first devlog for Tears Apart! We're excited to share the progress we’ve made so far and give you a behind-the-scenes look at what we’ve been working on.

[h2]Secondary Skills & Exploration[/h2]
Recently, we’ve been discussing adding additional weapons for players to use alongside the dash attack. These secondary skills will be designed to complement the dash and allow for interesting builds, offering more variety in gameplay. Our goal is to provide a richer experience with more strategic options for players as they experiment with different combinations.

We’ve also been thinking about how progression will work throughout the game. We're aiming to give players as much freedom as possible in deciding which rooms to engage in. Players will be able to enter and exit most rooms at will, offering the flexibility to choose their battles. We believe this system will provide depth for players who understand risk-reward mechanics, while remaining intuitive and accessible for newcomers.

[h2]Development Progress[/h2]
On the development side, we’ve been focusing on making all the systems smooth, optimized, and highly expandable. This flexibility is key because it means we can easily implement the fantastic ideas and feedback we’ll be receiving from you, the community, as we move forward.

We’re also making sure that everything is designed to be as scalable as possible, allowing us to refine and improve the game throughout the development process.

[h2]Art & UI Design[/h2]
Our artist has been hard at work on one of the most crucial elements: the UI. This is key to making the game not only visually appealing but also easy to understand. We’re currently working on essential features like the map and build display, which will help guide players as they explore and battle through the cosmos.

We can’t wait to share more with you as we continue to fine-tune the visuals and make Tears Apart an unforgettable experience!

[h2]Thank You![/h2]
A huge thank you to everyone who has added Tears Apart to their Wishlist! Honestly, the game has been getting wishlisted much faster than we expected, and we couldn’t be more thrilled! Your support has exceeded our expectations, and we’re incredibly grateful for it. It truly motivates us to keep pushing forward and making Tears Apart the best it can be.

Thanks for reading, and as always, feel free to share your thoughts and feedback. We’re so excited to continue this journey with you!
